subject: Renewal: NimbleRetail annual commit increase + tier rebalance
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: olivia.chen@nimbleretail.com, raj@nimbleretail.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal — annual commit increase + tier rebalance

Hi Olivia / Raj,

Thanks again for the Q2 check-in — great to see the 38% month-over-month growth on the personalization endpoints. Per our conversation, attached is a slim amendment that would: 

- Move NimbleRetail to a 12-month committed plan at 600M token/month (up from 350M).
- Introduce a graduated tier structure to lower unit rates for 600–900M and a soft-burst bucket for seasonal peaks.
- Keep the existing latency SLA for your core routes and add explicit burst credits during Black Friday window.

High-level commercials (in the attached PDF):
- Effective start: 2026-10-01
- Monthly committed tokens: 600M
- Unit price band: tier1 (0–600M): $0.0009/token; tier2 (600–900M): $0.00075/token
- Burst bank: 200M tokens per month for 3 months (prorated)

Action items for NimbleRetail: please confirm the preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly invoice) and whether you need an extended burst for Nov–Dec. If those look good, I can route the amendment for signature and loop in finance for PO timing.

I attached the amendment draft and a short CSV with your Q2 usage breakout we pulled from the console.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: NimbleRenewal_Amendment_v1.pdf (pdf), usage_metrics_q2.csv (csv)

From: olivia.chen@nimbleretail.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — annual commit increase + tier rebalance

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the proposal and the usage file — that was helpful. A few quick clarifying questions before we sign: 

1) On the tiered unit price: is the tier2 band applied retroactively within the same billing month, or only on tokens above 600M? We want the lower rate to apply to overflow above 600M only.
2) For the burst bank: can we convert unused burst credits to a multiplier for the following month if we don’t use them? Seasonality is unpredictable and we’d prefer carry-forward vs. expiry.
3) On SLA and throttling: if we hit sustained spikes (longer than 2 hours), what’s the escalation path to avoid mitigation that affects our customer-facing flows?

We’re inclined to the 600M commit but need those two pieces clarified. Also want to confirm: will the pricing be annualized in the renewals UI (we need a line-item for the commit credit on our AP side).

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform | NimbleRetail
olivia.chen@nimbleretail.com

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal — NimbleRetail (need pricing confirmation + SLA guardrails)

FYI — forwarding Olivia’s questions. Need quick internal alignment before I reply. My read: we can keep overflow pricing so tier2 only applies to tokens above 600M (standard). For burst credits, finance prefers no carry-forward beyond the contract month, but we can offer one-time Nov–Dec extension as a concession.

Karthik — can you confirm discounted unit price floor we can offer if they commit to 18 months instead of 12? Ben — what’s the earliest we can get PO-approved pricing into Stripe/NetSuite so Olivia has line items for AP?

Proposed internal concession (subject to your OK):
- Keep tier2 applied to overflow only.
- Allow burst carry-forward of up to 50M tokens for one month only (one-time concession) OR extend Nov–Dec burst by +100M as an alternative.
- If customer signs 18 months, provide an additional 5% off unit rates across bands (applies prospectively).

I’ve attached the amendment draft we’ll send once agreed.

— Lauren

Forwarded attachment: NimbleRenewal_Amendment_v1.pdf

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal — NimbleRetail (need pricing confirmation + SLA guardrails)

Thanks — quick answers below.

- Tier behavior: confirm tier2 applies only to overflow above 600M.
- Burst credits: we can offer a one-time carry-forward of up to 50M tokens into the immediate next month, or extend Nov–Dec burst by 100M (preferred operationally). Call that the "seasonal buffer".
- 18-month option: approved for an additional 5% discount across both bands (legal to draft language).
- Billing/UI: Ben, finance needs a PO template line that shows (1) monthly commit credit, (2) month-over-month usage, (3) burst consumption. Can your team produce that CSV export by EOD Monday?

SLA escalation: ops will commit to a Tier-1 on-call page at Redwood and a named escalation lead (we’ll put that contact into the amendment). If there’s a sustained spike >2 hours, we will: (a) open a priority incident, (b) provision short-term routing to a spare capacity pool, (c) if needed, enable temporary soft-degrade on low-priority endpoints and notify you 15 minutes prior. We’ll capture exact playbook in the SLO appendix.

Lauren — reply to Olivia with these concrete options and the DocuSign link. If they confirm 18 months, we’ll bake in the 5% and route to legal.

— Karthik

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
